problem: skill-graph.mjs exposes parsing, discovery, graph construction, persistence, propagation, ranking, and diagnostics as separate caller-facing functions; platform growth is also above its declared LOC ceiling.

seam.name: Skill Graph Index interface
seam.responsibility: Own graph lifecycle, normalized skill ingestion, deterministic ranking, snapshot consistency, persistence policy, and graph diagnostics.

operations.name: refresh
operations.invariant: atomically replaces one immutable graph snapshot

operations.name: find
operations.input: query string and optional positive bounded limit
operations.invariant: exact/keyword seeds outrank pure neighborhood activation

operations.name: diagnostics
operations.invariant: reports freshness, counts, unresolved references, and source fingerprint

depth.leverage: One routing contract serves CLI, evaluation, MCP, and future consumers.
depth.locality: Graph policy, source normalization, ranking, and persistence changes stay inside the index.
depth.test_surface: Interface-level tests cover source equivalence, deterministic refresh, ranking precedence, errors, atomic snapshots, and storage isolation.

migration: Define normalized source and result types.
Wrap existing pure graph behavior without changing ranking semantics.
Migrate evaluation, trajectory, trace improvement, marketplace export, and MCP callers.
Keep CLI commands as a thin adapter.
Replace private representation tests with interface tests.
Split validator/runtime directories internally after the index seam is stable.
decision: Adopt the Skill Graph Index as the single external seam; keep validator/runtime separation internal rather than exposing a second public seam.
